The difference is significant.

For the 'Cognitive State' (helpless tone) dimension, model 1 is the winner. Model 2, by contrast, fails to express helplessness. Its tone is one of wise reflection and acceptance, sounding more like a grandfather telling a story than someone feeling helpless.
